integrity: Proof by positive-node quadrature, Vandermonde rank, exact polynomial moment errors; supporting exact-rational verification is finite and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Universal rank upper bound only for constant rank-one forcing and zero initial matrix; exact attainment and Loewner-error signs proved for canonical undamped controllable integrator chains. No general signed bound, roundoff guarantee, or performance claim.
title: Exact rank delays and Loewner-error phase transitions in IF-SSPRK Gramians
